other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya
Applicant must be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture
Applicant must have a minimum cultivated area of 0.2 hectares
Applicant should be willing to invest for future expansion in planting materials and infrastructure
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on quality flower planting material and a free polyhouse up to 100 sqm per unit.
